title: Nest Hub Soli sleep tracking will migrate from Google Fit to Health app
summary: Strings in Google Home 4.23 for Android today detail “How your Nest Hub works with Google Health.” Basically, Google has updated the strings to replace mentions of Google Fit with Google Health.
